question: What is something your roommate did that you will never forget?
story: My roommate paid his rent for eight months using money he was quietly stealing from our own kitchen jar. We kept a house fund on the counter for shared groceries and bills. Everyone dropped forty bucks in every week, no questions asked. My roommate was always somehow broke, yet he never once struggled to cover his share. One night I could not sleep and shuffled out for water at three in the morning. There he was, counting the jar by the light of his phone, peeling off exactly his rent amount. He had been recycling our own money back to us for months. The best part? He genuinely thought he was a genius. When I confronted him, he just shrugged and said, technically I never missed a payment. He was not wrong. He was also not my roommate much longer. I kept the jar. I did not keep him.
